system.description:
Favoured weapon: Mace, Heavy

Granted power: Once per round, when an undead takes a hit from you or fails a save against your spell, it takes +1d6 radiant damage and can't regain HP until the end of its next turn. Once/day, when you use Turn Undead, dawn light fills its area: every enemy in it that is not undead also makes a Will save or is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

Allegiance: Neutral Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Lathander in the World of Arneyan wiki.
